testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/address-book-validate-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Address Book > validate address book functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in registered user opens the Address Book, checks the heading and the Add Address link, creates a new address with a unique display name (prefix + timestamp), checks the created toast, finds the address in the list and deletes it, checking the deleted toast. afterEach deletes any address left with the prefix.
steps: Open Address Book (signed in through the shared storageState); check heading and 'Add Address' link
Add Address: fill display name (prefix + Date.now()), street, first/last name, phone, city, postal code; save; check the created toast
Reopen Address Book, check the address is listed, delete it, check the deleted toast
afterEach: delete addresses whose display name starts with the prefix
stateChanges: An address is created on the signed-in account and deleted again (afterEach cleans up by prefix)
evidence: Title 'validate address book functionality' and the step labels match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts, AUTH_SPECS my-account/**) signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, whose account is getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, set in the git-ignored .env.<env>, not in the test's JSON). Source 0 records that credential (masked). The test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) before its first step (the same account as the session)

Store MaxwellsHardware: webstore-auth uses testimEnv.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, default webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; the account's recorded records (orders, saved carts) are on PortalId 7 = MaxwellsHardware (tda rows)

The test needs no record from the environment besides the account: every address value is typed in by the test (created-by-test); the masked heading and toasts are fixed UI text masked only because their keys contain 'address'
